sources.entry: Fantastical - The calendar app you won't be able to live without.

summary.name: Fantastical
summary.one_liner: Fantastical is a calendar and task app from Flexibits that combines multiple calendar accounts into one view and creates events from natural language input.
use_cases: merge work and personal calendars into one view
quickly add events by typing natural language
share availability and schedule meetings with others
plan trips across multiple time zones
create reusable templates for frequent events
summary.what_it_does: Fantastical connects to existing calendar accounts such as Google, Microsoft 365, Exchange, iCloud, Todoist, and CalDAV, and shows them in one organized view. Users can create events and tasks by typing natural language, and the page says the built-in AI can also extract details from a forwarded email. It offers day, week, month, quarter, and year views plus a DayTicker, along with a 10-day weather forecast in calendar views. The page also describes scheduling tools that include openings, RSVP handling, event proposals, and automatic conference call links.
notable: Natural language event and task entry, with forwarded emails parsed by built-in AI
Scheduling features: openings, event proposals, and RSVP tracking
Automatic conference call link detection for many services, including Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams
Calendar widgets, Lock Screen widgets, and Focus Filters on iPhone
caveats: Some features require Fantastical Premium, which the page describes as unlocking new features
Android support is announced for 2027 only, and Googlebook is listed as new
Some scheduling and sync features depend on a Flexibits Account
